verses.text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.

segments.text: I said, I will take heed to my ways,
That I sin not with my tongue:
I will keep my mouth with a bridle,
While the wicked is before me.

verses.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

segments.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good;
And my sorrow was stirred.

verses.text: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned; Then spake I with my tongue:

segments.text: My heart was hot within me;
While I was musing the fire burned;
Then
spake I with my tongue:

verses.text: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.

segments.text: Jehovah, make me to know mine end,
And the measure of my days, what it is;
Let me know how frail I am.

verses.text: Behold, thou hast made my days as handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. [Selah

segments.text: Behold, thou hast made my days
as
handbreadths;
And my life-time is as nothing before thee:
Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. [Selah

verses.text: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

segments.text: Surely every man walketh in a vain show;
Surely they are disquieted in vain:
He heapeth up
riches
, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.

segments.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for?
My hope is in thee.

verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

segments.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions:
Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.

segments.text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth;
Because thou didst it.

verses.text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

segments.text: Remove thy stroke away from me:
I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

verses.text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. [Selah

segments.text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity,
Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth:
Surely every man is vanity. [Selah

verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.

segments.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry;
Hold not thy peace at my tears:
For I am a stranger with thee,
A sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.

segments.text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength,
Before I go hence, and be no more.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
